mapper.query:
SELECT 
    cj.candidate_id,
    cj.joborder_id,
    
    /* 1. LIMPIEZA DEL NÚMERO DE DOCUMENTO (Sin puntos, sin comas, sin espacios) */
    REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(c.national_id_number), '.', ''), ',', '') AS cedula,
    
    /* 2. TRADUCCIÓN DEL TIPO DE DOCUMENTO (Para API Tusdatos) */
    CASE 
        WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Ciudadan%' THEN 'CC'
        WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Extranjer%' OR c.SOBIDnumber LIKE 'Cedula de%' THEN 'CE'
        WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Pasaporte%' THEN 'PP' 
        WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Permanente%' THEN 'PPT'
        ELSE 'CC' 
    END AS document_type,

    /* 3. FORMATEO DE LA FECHA DE EXPEDICIÓN */
    FORMAT_DATE('%d/%m/%Y', SAFE_CAST(c.candidDOJ AS DATE)) AS issue_date,

    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email1,
    jo.state AS regional,

    /* 4. FECHA DE MODIFICACIÓN EN ATS (Control de re-procesos) */
    FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', cj.date_modified) AS ats_date_modified
    
FROM `g4s-data-management.Global_ATS.candidate_joborder` cj
INNER JOIN `g4s-data-management.Global_ATS.candidate` c 
    ON cj.candidate_id = c.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN `g4s-data-management.Global_ATS.joborder` jo
    ON cj.joborder_id = jo.joborder_id

WHERE c.country_id = 47
  AND cj.status = 1018
  AND jo.status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Closed')
  
  /* FILTRO DE TIEMPO */
  AND cj.date_modified >= DATETIME_SUB(CURRENT_DATETIME(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

ORDER BY cj.date_modified DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT

cj.candidate_id,

cj.joborder_id,

/* 1. LIMPIEZA DEL NÚMERO DE DOCUMENTO (Sin puntos, sin comas, sin espacios) */

REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(c.national_id_number), '.', ''), ',', '') AS cedula,

/* 2. TRADUCCIÓN DEL TIPO DE DOCUMENTO (Para API Tusdatos) */

CASE

WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Ciudadan%' THEN 'CC'

WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Extranjer%' OR c.SOBIDnumber LIKE 'Cedula de%' THEN 'CE'

WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Pasaporte%' THEN 'PP'

WHEN c.SOBIDnumber LIKE '%Permanente%' THEN 'PPT'

ELSE 'CC'

END AS document_type,

/* 3. FORMATEO DE LA FECHA DE EXPEDICIÓN */

FORMAT_DATE('%d/%m/%Y', SAFE_CAST(c.candidDOJ AS DATE)) AS issue_date,

c.first_name,

c.last_name,

c.email1,

jo.state AS regional,

/* 4. FECHA DE MODIFICACIÓN EN ATS (Control de re-procesos) */

FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', cj.date_modified) AS ats_date_modified

FROM `g4s-data-management.Global_ATS.candidate_joborder` cj

INNER JOIN `g4s-data-management.Global_ATS.candidate` c

ON cj.candidate_id = c.candidate_id

LEFT JOIN `g4s-data-management.Global_ATS.joborder` jo

ON cj.joborder_id = jo.joborder_id

WHERE c.country_id = 47

AND cj.status = 1018

AND jo.status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Closed')

/* FILTRO DE TIEMPO */

AND cj.date_modified >= DATETIME_SUB(CURRENT_DATETIME(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)

ORDER BY cj.date_modified DESC

LIMIT 50
